comment: Purposes offered when a project gets its system; each one recommends a desktop, login screen, look, applications and more. Every recommendation can be unticked.

profiles.name: Education
profiles.description: Schools and learning: light Xfce desktop (or choose Eduka-Desktop on the Desktop page), learning programs, accessibility, simple for children and teachers.

profiles.name: Server
profiles.description: No desktop: remote administration over SSH, firewall, automatic security updates. Start from the Debian live standard ISO (no desktop).

profiles.name: Professional
profiles.description: Office work and design: KDE Plasma, office, mail, graphics, remote desktop and password manager.

profiles.name: Home
profiles.description: Families: Cinnamon (familiar, like Linux Mint), internet, music, photos, video and games.

profiles.name: Other / my own
profiles.description: No recommendations: build everything yourself, page by page.

iso_editions.name: Minimal
iso_editions.description: Smallest ISO: the desktop in its Mini edition, firmware and the installer. No extra applications.

iso_editions.name: Full
iso_editions.description: The complete desktop and the applications for this purpose.

iso_editions.name: Full with recommended apps
iso_editions.description: Full, plus the desktop's recommended applications and the Flatpak apps (largest ISO). Recommended.
